acceptance_predicates.description: A bounded local development acquisition backend serves pinned fixture archives without credentials or ambient network.
Fixture archives retain the exact AR-1781 catalog identity and are rejected on digest, revision, or evaluator mismatch.
Every AR-1781 development workload can install, select, run, sweep, report, and compare offline after setup.
Acquisition/backend failures remain distinct from benchmark/provider failures and preserve prior usable state.

definition_of_done: A reviewed controlled backend and public fixture mode qualify every AR-1781 development workload through the AR-1780 journey with exact identity evidence.

gates.description: Every AR-1781 development workload passes bounded install/select/run/sweep/report/compare fixture coverage.
